blocks.text: Tsawwassen Detached Homes Under $1.8M — Frequently Asked Questions

parts.t: What types of detached houses are available under $1.8M in Tsawwassen?

How does financing work on Tsawwassen North leasehold detached homes?

Residential lots in Tsawwassen Shores and Tsawwassen Landing are held on 99-year prepaid leases with Tsawwassen First Nation. Major Canadian banks and credit unions offer standard residential mortgages amortized up to 25 or 30 years because the lease is prepaid up front.
Do Tsawwassen homes under $1.8M have basements?

Unlike Ladner and Beach Grove (which sit on low-lying delta floodplain soils where crawlspaces or slab foundations are standard), upland neighbourhoods in Tsawwassen Central, Pebble Hill, Cliff Drive, and English Bluff sit on elevated ground where split-level and full daylight basements are common.
Are secondary suites permitted in Tsawwassen detached houses?

Yes. City of Delta zoning permits one registered secondary suite inside single-family detached dwellings, provided building-code fire separation, ceiling height, and off-street parking requirements are met.
Which schools serve Tsawwassen's detached neighbourhoods?

All public elementary catchments in Tsawwassen (Cliff Drive Elementary, Beach Grove Elementary, South Park Elementary, Pebble Hill Elementary, and English Bluff Elementary) feed into South Delta Secondary School (SDSS) in central Tsawwassen.
Are there monthly fees for detached homes in Tsawwassen North or Tsawwassen Springs?

Detached houses at Tsawwassen Springs are bare-land strata lots with a monthly strata fee for private road and common grounds upkeep, while Tsawwassen North detached homes pay a modest monthly homeowners association / common infrastructure fee alongside annual property taxes.
